firmware_identity_limit: Capture BUILD reply has no Git hash; match final-03 flash manifest independently. Review HEAD is not proof of flashed binary.

captures.label: volt1-02

gap_diagnostic_correlation.interpretation: All 25 missing scientific frames have bounded CRC diagnostics. Count equals sinkDropped delta minus lineDropped delta (25). This is consistent with data sink rejection while diagnostic lines survive; counters alone do not establish individual drop cause.

scientific_validity.X02_semantics: SPI-class invalid cell; the bounded CRC diagnostic confirms CRC-rejected masks only for observed diagnostic records. Missing logs are not assumed successful.

adc_crc.counter_window_limit: Deltas apply only between stated same-boot snapshots, not exactly the collector duration. ADSSPIBYTES is bounded diagnostic evidence, not every error byte.

rate.rate_limit: Sequence progress is firmware frame progression per device timestamp; completed host frames prove this collector received bytes. SF50 overlapping rolling windows are not summed.

semantics: sinkQueued counts accepted sink slots, not whole scientific frames.
sinkDropped includes sink failures and line-drop events; lineDropped is not additive to it.
driverAcceptedBytes is bytes accepted by ESP-IDF driver, not PC acknowledgement.
driverDrained counts observed wait_tx_done success; it does not count frames or PC application receipt.
rxBytes is firmware control RX; host collector rx_bytes is actual received raw bytes.
sofPresent=1 is reported hardware SOF status at query; enumerated remains unknown.
lineDropped/discardBytes are line-assembler losses, not a complete measurement-frame gap count.

acceptance_limits: No MFAULT is not proof ADC CRC is repaired.
Complete ASCII frames are not proof all analog points valid.
No absolute VOLT accuracy acceptance established in these recordings.
Absence of allCrcRun escalation means HIL did not exercise its three-sweep isolation boundary.
